steps.en: Install it and enable the resident agent (the GUI is only an editor)
steps.zh: 安装并启用常驻 agent（GUI 只是编辑器）

steps.en: Takes the HID++ and camera handles and enumerates your devices
steps.zh: 接管 HID++ 与摄像头句柄，枚举设备

steps.en: Declare what each button does in one TOML file
steps.zh: 在一个 TOML 里声明每个按键做什么

steps.en: Diverts the bound controls and injects the replacement action
steps.zh: 接管已绑定的控件并注入替代动作

steps.en: Swaps in the matching overlay when the foreground app changes
steps.zh: 前台应用切换时换用对应动作叠加层

value.en: Buttons, per-app profiles and camera settings live in one TOML file and survive without the vendor app
value.zh: 按键、按应用 profile 与摄像头设置都落在同一个 TOML 里，不依赖厂商应用

sources: README.md Install (brew install --cask openlogi, dpkg/rpm/pacman, systemctl --user enable --now openlogi-agent.service, Windows GUI+agent pair)
README.md Features (button remapping via the OS input hook, per-application profile overlays, Litra lights, UVC webcam controls)
docs/CONFIGURATION.md (config.toml path per OS, schema_version, per_app_bindings, bindings, action_ring, cameras)
